messages:
maria: async standup — quick onboards + noisy evals

maria: what I did: landed a tokenizer normalization fix for the multilingual promptset (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/421). fixes nonbreaking-space mishandling that was corrupting a few Spanish/French examples. no perf regression in microbench.

maria: blocker: nightly eval harness intermittently times out on long-chain reasoning prompts (>=1024 tokens). failing in the harness, not in local server runs. stack traces show repeated retries then timeout.

alex: nice catch on NBSP stuff, that bit me earlier too. which harness job is failing? job name? :eyes:

maria: failing job: eval/multi_longreason/runner-42. timeout after 12m. repro logs attached in CI but gist below. I suspect the harness keeps retrying a few request variants and then hits the global timeout.

jordan: I saw similar timeouts yesterday. hypothesis: KV-cache warmup + our long context batching causes the server to stall for one request while it warms, then retries queue up. we should increase per-request timeout for these long traces in harness config. pinging @eng-runtime for a knob.

sam: can you paste the failing log snippet? also, is the golden promptset still fixed, or did the tokenizer change shift expectations for eval outputs? we need to know if this is infra flake vs real regression.

maria: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-16T20:02:10Z INF request id=abc123 model=vicuna-33k seq=2048 status=started
2026-03-16T20:02:11Z INF kvcache warmup cost_ms=4521
2026-03-16T20:02:15Z INF request id=abc123 status=retrying attempt=1 reason=queue_wait
2026-03-16T20:14:35Z ERR request id=abc123 status=timeout total_ms=730000
```
this looks like a long warmup then queue/backoff. the tokenizer normalization PR removed the spurious Unicode char but didn't change token counts materially.

alex: ok thanks. sounds infra-y. if eng-runtime increases the long-request timeout by ~30-60s for the nightly sweep we can get more stable signals. we can also mark these specific longreason tests as flaky while we triage.

eval-bot: scheduled: nightly-run eval/multi_longreason rerun at 2026-03-17T07:00:00Z (CI job id 9876).

jordan: for immediate mitigation I pushed a quick harness change — increase job-level timeout to 15m and add a smaller-retry backoff. PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/harness/pull/88. requesting review from @sam.

sam: reviewing now. quick comment: can we add a small KV-cache warmup stub that sends a cheap short request before the heavy ones? that should reduce the first-request tail.

maria: good idea. I'll add a short warmup call to the test runner for long traces. also will run a focused sweep against the new tokenizer branch to ensure no eval drift. planning: add warmup + re-run nightly, update results channel by EOD.

alex: sweet. ping me if you need help with the PR or canary rollout scheduling. I'm around this afternoon for a quick pairing. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — will post results after the rerun. if infra still flakes we'll open an incident ticket.

sam: noted — I'll follow up with eng-runtime about an env var to control warmup behavior.

eval-bot: info: rerun queued (job 9876 -> runner-5).

maria: +1 closing loop: today: add harness warmup, trigger re-run, monitor diffs for tokenizer changes. blockers: eng-runtime timeout knob and CI slot contention.
